decisions.reason: The copper-coated glass substrates under the publicly announced ACT initiative sit close to the core offer and fit the declared push into 3D-integration and high-frequency applications, and the firm has invested in them and promoted them visibly, so management keeps them even though their market traction is still unclear.

VLIS was launched only in 2024 on a dedicated page as a next-generation technology central to the firm's strategy for higher-value semiconductor applications, so the investment and public commitment are strong and early weak results would be read as a temporary ramp-up.
